公司決定再贊助這家俱樂部五年，成了俱樂部的救星。

NONE: › small electric lights on a string used as decoration, especially on trees at Christmas
（尤指聖誕樹上的）彩色小燈
› a traditional story written for children that usually involves imaginary creatures and magic
童話故事
› having a special and attractive or beautiful quality, like something in a fairy tale
童話般的

example: They had a fairy-tale wedding.
他們舉行了童話般的婚禮。
Sadly, there was no fairy-tale happy ending to the story.
不幸的是，故事並沒有童話般的幸福結局。

U: › [ U ] the place where fairies (= imaginary creatures) are said to live
› [ U ] mainly UK disapproving an imaginary perfect place or situation, where you do not have to deal with real problems in a practical way
樂土；世外桃源；不切實際的情境
S: › [ S ] approving a beautiful place with an attractive or special quality

example: It had snowed heavily during the night and in the morning the city was a white fairyland.
夜裡大雪紛紛，清晨城市成了白色的仙境。
The Minister's argument belongs to fairyland.
部長的論據完全不切實際。

NONE: › something that has already happened or been done and cannot be changed
既成事實

example: The policy change was presented to us as a fait accompli, without consultation or discussion.
未經磋商或討論，政策上的變化就已成既成事實擺在我們面前。

U: B2 [ U ] great trust or confidence in something or someone
B2 [ U ] strong belief in God or a particular religion

example: She has no faith in modern medicine.
她對現代醫學沒有信心。
You'll cope - I have great faith in you.
你應付得了——我對你很有信心。

審判之後，他的家人說，他們對司法體系已完全失去信心。
Politicians must start keeping their promises if they want to restore the people's faith in government.
如果眾政治人物想恢復人們對政府的信任，他們必須開始信守承諾。
the Muslim/Christian/Jewish/Buddhist faith
伊斯蘭教／基督教／猶太教／佛教
They were persecuted for their faith.
他們因宗教信仰而遭受迫害。
He was forced to practise his faith in secret.
他被迫對自己的宗教信仰保密。
a multi-faith society
宗教信仰多元化的社會
They were brought up in the true faith (= the religion which the speaker believes is the only true one).
他們在正統的宗教薰陶下長大。
Even in the bad times she never lost her faith.
即使在困難時期，她也從未喪失信仰。
Her faith in God was shattered when her baby died.
她的孩子死後，她對上帝的信仰破滅了。
It's my faith that keeps me going.
是我的信仰給我前進的動力。

NONE: › if someone's beliefs and confidence are strong enough, they can achieve something that is very difficult
精誠所至，金石為開。
› a person who cures sick people by using the power of prayer and belief
用信仰療法治病的人
› a school that is financially supported by a particular religious group, usually for children from that religion
宗教學校（由某一宗教團體資助的學校，在校生通常為信仰該宗教的孩子）

example: a Muslim faith school
穆斯林宗教學校
I would never send my child to a faith school.
我絕對不會把自己的孩子送去教會學校。

NONE: › relating to organizations or government policies that are based on religious beliefs
（機構或政府政策）基於宗教信仰的

example: a faith-based community initiative
宗教社區倡議

NONE: B2 firm and not changing in your friendship with or support for a person or an organization, or in your belief in your principles
忠誠的；忠實的

（配偶或性伴侶）忠誠的，忠貞的
› to continue to support or follow something
對…忠誠
› true or not changing any of the details, facts, style, etc. of the original
如實的，絲毫不作改動的
› following a particular religion
虔誠的

C: › someone who continues to support someone or something

NONE: › people who are always loyal to a particular group or organization, especially a political party

虔誠信眾，忠實信徒

忠誠的朋友

他們是工黨的忠實擁護者。

無論去哪裡，他那隻忠誠的老狗總是陪伴左右。
Was your wife faithful during your marriage?
你的妻子婚後忠誠嗎？

在30年的婚姻生活中，他一直忠於妻子。

在很多人都公開反對當局時，他仍忠心耿耿。
Despite persecution, she remained faithful to her beliefs.
儘管受到迫害，她仍忠於她的信仰。
She gave a faithful account of what had happened on that night.
她如實講述了那晚發生的事情。
I have tried to keep my translation as faithful as possible to the original book.
我盡力使我的翻譯忠實於原著。
He gave a rousing speech to a room full of party faithfuls (= faithful supporters of a political party).
他向滿屋子的該政黨擁護者發表了激動人心的講話。
They asked for donations from the party faithful.
他們要求忠誠的黨員捐款。
We heard bells calling the faithful to prayer.
我們聽到召集信徒去祈禱的鐘聲。

NONE: › in a loyal way or a way that can be trusted
忠誠地；忠實地

› in a way that is true or accurate

NONE: › the quality of being faithful to someone or something

example: The priest stressed the importance of faithfulness in marriage.
牧師強調了婚姻中忠誠的重要性。

NONE: › not loyal and not able to be trusted
不忠誠的；不可信賴的

（配偶或性伴侶）不忠貞的

無宗教信仰的
